label: Requests for co-founders
title: I came to the US with nothing and built companies for immigrants. Now I want to build the next ones with you.
intro: Hey, I'm Siam. Over fifteen years I've guided more than two hundred thousand students abroad, helped immigrants earn millions in US salaries, and run a fund for the ones who made it. Along the way I kept finding problems that deserve a company and don't have one.

These are those openings. Pick one, or bring yours. Tell me what you're great at — building or selling — and we put in the rest: capital, engineering or distribution, decades of wisdom, and our entire ecosystem behind you.

pillars.v: Hand-picked from nearly two thousand by the demand behind them and by whether one of our companies already reaches the customer. Each is a one-pager on purpose; the full research comes once we're talking.
Every founder is missing a leg. Builders lack distribution; sellers lack a product. We map what you don't have and back you with it — capital, network, engineering or go-to-market. Whatever it takes.
Co-founder, equity. Not an agency, not an accelerator. We form the US company, tackle the immigration and visa questions with you, and bring the team, the audience and the operating history.

whoIntro: Immigrant founders, solo founders ideally. International students and international founders get preference — I've been one, I've built for hundreds of thousands of them, and I know the constraints. Two profiles, and you only need to be one.

icps.name: The Builder
icps.line: A 10× engineer who ships with AI tools at rocket speed and cares how it feels to use.
you: Build end to end — backend, frontend, data, deploy — alone if you have to
Fluent with today's AI coding tools; a working product in weeks, not quarters
Product-minded: you sweat the user experience, not just the architecture
Have shipped something real, even if nobody bought it
we: Distribution — the customers, communities and channels our companies already reach
The first ten conversations, opened for you
Capital and a US company when it's time

icps.name: The Storyteller
icps.line: A seller or a creator who moves people — with a pipeline, or with an audience that already listens.
you: Can sell anything to anyone, and prove it with a pipeline you've run
Or: make content people actually consume, with a distribution you already own
Live inside a customer community and speak its language
Comfortable charging money from day one
we: Engineering — Algorizin's team builds the product while you sell
The operating playbook from companies that already sell to this audience
Capital and a US company when it's time

ideasIntro: Sixty to start, more as we write them. They follow one life in three stages — arrive, rise, thrive — and each has a company of ours behind it that already reaches the people it serves. Titles are listed now; each one-pager goes live as it's written. Tap a stage.

help.v: You sell, we build. Algorizin's delivery team ships the MVP to your spec.
220,000+ students guided abroad and $13M+ in immigrant salaries placed — an audience that already trusts us.
Fifteen years of running companies in these exact markets, and the mistakes already made.
Weekly working sessions with me on strategy, pricing and hiring, for as long as it takes to find product-market fit.

steps.k: Pick an idea, or bring yours
steps.v: Any one-pager above, or something you've seen that we haven't.
Thirty minutes. Builder or storyteller, what you've shipped or sold, where you are in the world.
I say plainly what you're missing and what we'd put in.
Company formed, product or pipeline live, first revenue — all inside ninety days. Then we decide together how big it gets.

closeText: Thirty minutes, no deck needed. Bring what you've built or sold and the idea you can't stop thinking about.
footer: Requests for Co-founders is run by Siam Hossain and Algorizin, Inc. Ideas are shared as one-pagers on purpose; the research behind each is shared with people we start working with.
matchTitle: You bring one thing. We bring the rest.
